name: ELYVERA
shipsTo: EU Member States and selected associated countries, explicitly including Liechtenstein and Monaco
legalEntity: Elyvera Biotech GmbH, Bösendorferstraße 4/20, 1010 Vienna, Austria; FN 676291 x; VAT ID ATU83240039 (shop legal notice).
coaAccess: Public batch library with shop-hosted Janoshik PDFs. For 2 of 4 primary reports the lab-hosted covers were read and matched; for the other 2, only analytical text could be read from the lab-hosted PDFs. Separate lab-hosted endotoxin reports matched 3 sampled lots.
freeShippingThreshold: €100 for free shipping to selected destinations or half-price shipping elsewhere; €300 for free shipping to all eligible destinations (shop banner).
dispatchInfo: The policy states dispatch from Vienna, Austria, normally 1–3 business days after payment confirmation. Austrian Post Standard estimates 1–3 business days for Austria or 3–7 for international Europe; DHL Express estimates 1 business day for Austria or 1–4 for international Europe.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: 2 of 4 primary reports were read and matched on the lab domain; 2 primary reports had data-only corroboration, while separate endotoxin reports were matched on the lab domain for 3 lots.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: The 2 fully matched primary reports give 111.0% and 119.5% of label; the shop-hosted Mots-C and GHK-Cu covers give 103.2% and 112.6% respectively, the latter on a total GHK-Cu basis.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: The sampled PDFs document HPLC purity, LC-MS, net content, heavy metals and, in some lots, endotoxin, residual TFA, pH and TAMC/TYMC; microbial counts do not establish sterility.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The legal notice gives the operator, Vienna address, company registration number and VAT ID; these disclosures were not independently checked against a registry.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: The written policy names the dispatch city, the processing window, carriers and delivery estimates for Austria and international European destinations; the complete destination list was not checked.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: Public in-stock single-unit prices span approximately €0.50–€4.99 per nominal mg, excluding VAT and shipping; no market ranking was inferred from this spread.

strengths: Public, batch-numbered CoA library; 2 sampled primary reports and supplemental endotoxin reports for 3 lots were matched directly on Janoshik's domain.
Named legal operator and separately specified dispatch city, with published carrier estimates.
weaknesses: 2 of 4 primary report covers could not be read on the lab domain; their lab extracts do not show the client and batch fields.
The GHK-Cu cover says 50 mg, but the associated chromatogram's internal sample name says 10mg; the reported 56.31 mg total includes 8.58 mg of copper.
Both fully matched primary reports measured more than 10% above label.
verdict: ELYVERA publishes a batch-indexed Janoshik library. Two primary report covers matched on product, client and lot on the lab domain; for two others only analytical text was accessible there. Separate Janoshik endotoxin reports matched 3 sampled lots. The Vienna legal notice address and Vienna dispatch origin are separate disclosures.
summary: Austrian research-reagent shop on europeptides.de, operated by Elyvera Biotech GmbH. elyvera.com redirects to the same storefront. The shop publishes batch PDFs, single-unit prices excluding VAT, and dispatch terms from Vienna.
notes: The source for the 50 mg Triple Receptor Agonist is the public listing, which uses the alias Reta; the 10 mg sampled Janoshik report names Retatrutide. The shop's 50 mg listing was out of stock. Prices are for 1 unit, excluding VAT; crossed-out comparison prices are recorded separately from the current single-unit price. The BPC-157 cover on both domains prints EuroPeptides as client; the audit does not infer corporate succession. For tasks 157499 and 200041, lab PDF extraction exposed analytical tables but not the cover, so exact lot/client verification for those primary reports is not claimed. Same-lot endotoxin reports are independently verified as separate tests. The GHK-Cu quantification is the total on the shop cover, not the GHK-only figure. The shop does not publish the complete destination list or all payment options outside checkout in the policies read.
